answer: Cap earning seats per epoch and sell them in a sealed burn auction: every key bids POA that is destroyed, win or lose, and only the top bids earn rewards that epoch. Price becomes an honest signal of expected value, so a farm of a thousand keys must burn a thousand winning bids, and each clone merely mirrors its siblings while raising the clearing price for itself. Burned bids leave an umber ash trail on-chain that graders can audit, so wash-bidding to fake demand costs real tokens too.
